specs.prompt: Create one horizontal triptych for the original fantasy card-tactics game Sigils & Oaths. Exactly three equal square panels in one 3:1 image, no gaps or borders, no text, letters, numerals, symbols resembling text, watermarks or UI. Every panel is a separate evocative spell illustration, center its primary action in the middle third vertically so it remains clear when cropped to a wide card strip. Painterly gouache and oil, refined hand-painted fantasy illustration, antique gold, jade teal, deep indigo shadows, warm directional light, bold readable silhouettes, controlled detail, not photorealistic, no existing franchise characters. Match the reference art's brushwork and palette but do not copy its composition. Left panel: a brilliant amber fire lance streaming diagonally across a dark battlement, concentrated single hot core and trailing sparks. Middle panel: a ring of red-gold fire expanding across stone paving, viewed obliquely from above, bright circular impact and dark center. Right panel: two gloved hands releasing soft emerald and ivory healing radiance around a wounded armored arm, hopeful gentle motes.
